levels.title: First Putt
levels.teaching_goal: Learn aim, power preview, release, and gentle putting.
levels.layout_brief: A wide flat green, short approach, low boundary rails, obvious cup. No gap or active obstacle.
levels.solution_brief: A medium first putt and optional gentle correction. Allow one-shot skilled route.
validation_checks: Cup visible above bottom tray.
Touch completion before microphone onboarding.
Forgiving primary power band; no precision-only requirement.

levels.title: Soft Landing
levels.teaching_goal: Discover that less power can be the better choice.
levels.layout_brief: A broad approach leads to a short final green with a safe outer rail and a visible optional risky edge.
levels.solution_brief: Stop short of the edge, then use a gentle finishing putt; stronger first shot may bank safely with skill.
validation_checks: Overpower failure is visible and recoverable.
A newcomer can stage two safe shots.
No unseen cliff behind UI.

levels.title: Bank Buddy
levels.teaching_goal: Use a wall rebound to change direction.
levels.layout_brief: An L-shaped green with one clean bank wall; alternate slower two-turn route.
levels.solution_brief: Bank at moderate power toward the final green or take two deliberate setup shots.
validation_checks: Rail art and collider align.
Multiple approach directions remain solvable.
No clipping at corner module seams.

levels.title: Little Leap
levels.teaching_goal: Use ramp geometry and readable landing targets.
levels.layout_brief: One short ramp and modest gap to a wide landing green; side rails guide the approach.
levels.solution_brief: Set aim from the tee, choose a tested power band for the gap, then finish gently.
validation_checks: Low/medium/high power landing bands documented.
Fall returns to the last safe rest.
Landing green is visible before shooting.

levels.title: Gate Timing
levels.teaching_goal: Combine patient timing with a restrained shot.
levels.layout_brief: A single sliding gate across a straight lane, with a broad safe staging area before and after.
levels.solution_brief: Wait for the gate, then pass with moderate power; stage a short approach when needed.
validation_checks: Gate phase pauses consistently.
No inescapable pinning against a rail.
Gate travel region is visually obvious.

levels.title: Cliff Combo
levels.teaching_goal: Combine existing skills without introducing another system.
levels.layout_brief: Two broad islands linked by a low ramp; gate lies before the jump, not on the landing pad.
levels.solution_brief: Stage before the gate, pass and jump at a tested power band, then approach the cup.
validation_checks: One-star completion unlocks PP01 and Panda.
Independent safe route and optional efficient route.
No unfair simultaneous high-precision timing/power demand.

levels.title: Through the Ring
levels.teaching_goal: Learn matching portal symbols and safe exits.
levels.layout_brief: One visible pair connects two broad greens; entry and exit can be inspected together.
levels.solution_brief: Roll gently into the portal, observe exit direction, then putt toward the cup.
validation_checks: Exit is collision-free with radius clearance.
Pair latch prevents immediate return.
Only one pair, visually matched.

levels.title: Exit Angle
levels.teaching_goal: Plan using the portal exit orientation.
levels.layout_brief: One pair with rotated exit feeds a bank wall and broad final green.
levels.solution_brief: Choose an approach angle that exits along the intended rail, then correct at low power.
validation_checks: Velocity-direction mapping tested at oblique angles.
Exit arrow agrees with behavior.
Alternate slower setup route remains possible.

levels.title: Spring Step
levels.teaching_goal: Learn pad impulse and landing control.
levels.layout_brief: A pad sits on a broad approach and launches toward a wide raised platform. No portal on this introduction.
levels.solution_brief: Reach the pad with moderate rolling speed, land, then make a soft finishing shot.
validation_checks: Pad fires once per eligible contact.
Slow/side/repeated entry tests pass.
Misses reset to a valid safe anchor.

levels.title: Portal and Pad
levels.teaching_goal: Chain two known interactions with an optional staging stop.
levels.layout_brief: A portal exits before a pad rather than directly on it; a safe flat area separates them.
levels.solution_brief: Portal to staging, choose pad approach power, then finish after landing.
validation_checks: Exit cannot activate the pad before the player can understand it.
No pad/portal infinite-energy loop.
Intermediate safe rest exists.

levels.title: Gate Escape
levels.teaching_goal: Time a gate using a clearly signposted portal exit.
levels.layout_brief: A visible exit faces a gate corridor with generous staging distance and side rails.
levels.solution_brief: Move through the portal, stop before the gate, then time a moderate putt.
validation_checks: Gate cannot trap the ball at portal exit.
Overview shows full pairing and corridor.
Primary route does not require simultaneous portal/gate precision.

levels.title: Royal Route
levels.teaching_goal: Finish with route planning using previously learned mechanics.
levels.layout_brief: A compact finale with one portal pair, one pad, a ramp option, and broad staged greens. No new wind/lava system.
levels.solution_brief: Take a safe staged route using known power bands; skilled players combine steps for a lower score.
validation_checks: Independent routes fit twelve-stroke limit.
Robot unlock and final results work.
No mandatory exact-float shot or hidden target.
